title: Unit tests for isValidPayloadHex (src/economy/anchor-proxy-app.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/economy/anchor-payload-hex.test.ts` for `isValidPayloadHex` in `src/economy/anchor-proxy-app.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/economy/anchor-proxy-app.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: valid even-length hex (lower and upper case); empty string; odd length; non-hex characters; exactly 160 characters (valid) and 162 (too long); non-string values (number, null, undefined, object).
